in_sanskrit.name: अवनेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is not a lord or master of anything, or one who rules away from the material world.

in_hindi.name: अवनेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who leads away from the material world, or one who is not the master of anything in the material world.
